  [13] File: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`
      Problem: Lines: 2037, 2066, 2068; The tightened regex patterns for detectings editor edit claims removed the `es` suffix for the verbs `fix` and `patch`. The current pattern `fix(ed|ing)?` fails to match "Fixes a bug", which is a common present-tense third-person form used in AI-generated summaries.; In the fallback detection path (when the explicit "Change status:" field is missing), the workflow relies on these regexes to decide if the editor "claimed" to make changes. If an editor summary says "Fixes the typo", the current regex will not match. The workflow will conclude no changes were claimed, and if the git tree is also clean, it will fail to raise the `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` warning even if the editor intended to apply a fix. This bypasses a critical safety guard against silent failures.; **MINOR ISSUE: Typo in comment**
